title: First Lessons: the Veil
introNarration: Mentor Mist keeps the hearth dummy in sight. Pale curtains take the light and give it back in pieces. The air smells of cold stone and a little crushed lavender. "Look around this hearth. The mirror is only a mirror until you waste time in it. Defeat the hearth dummy in this room — not Flint's orchard dummy. Then come back and talk to me. I will open this School's leaf and ink its stem in your Field Primer."
reminderNarration: Look around this hearth. Defeat the hearth dummy here. Then talk to Mist. She has not filled the silence for you.
completionNarration: Mist inks the stem at rank I. The Primer's new lines are quiet on the page. The next lesson will ask you to cast.

objectives.label: Return and talk to Mentor Mist.
